notes: Fixed: MaskedReductionUtil.maskedPoolingConvolution (forward) and maskedPoolingEpsilonCnn (backward) had wrong N computation for AVG pooling. When mask has singleton dims (e.g. [mb,1,H,1] or [mb,1,1,W]), mask.sum(1,2,3) only counts non-broadcast positions. Fixed by expanding mask via repmat() to account for broadcast before summing: long repH = (mask.size(2)==1)?inH:1L; long repW = (mask.size(3)==1)?inW:1L; mask.repmat(1,1,repH,repW).sum(1,2,3). Also added BooleanIndexing zero-guard in backward pass. Affects GlobalPoolingGradientCheckTests.testCnnGlobalPoolingMasking. Files: deeplearning4j-nn/src/main/java/.../util/MaskedReductionUtil.java. deeplearning4j-nn installed successfully with Java-only build.
